subject: Temporary night-coverage SLA adjustment for AtlasPay launch weekend
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@atlaspay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: AtlasPay Engineering <eng@atlaspay.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary SLA coverage for launch weekend

Hi Ben,

We’re kicking off a constrained-but-critical launch this Friday (08/21) through Sunday (08/23). Traffic will spike and our SREs will be stretched supporting the new payment flows. We want to ask if Redwood can provide a temporary adjustment to the P1/P2 response windows during the launch window: specifically, guaranteed 30-minute for P1 and 2-hour for P2 for the 48-hour period starting Friday 06:00 PDT.

I know this is outside our standard SLA; we’re prepared to accept a short-term surcharge and provide a mutual action plan. Key asks:
- Confirm Redwood can commit to the shorter P1/P2 response windows for the launch window.
- Provide a named escalation contact and on-call roster for nights.
- Any required approvals or paperwork so procurement can sign off quickly.

Can you tell me what’s feasible by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Head of Platform
AtlasPay

---
attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 17:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA coverage for launch weekend

Samir —

Thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the launch. Short answer: we can support a temporary tightening of response windows for that specific 48-hour window, but we need to lock in a few mitigations and approvals first. Proposed approach: 

1) Temporary SLA amendment (Fri 06:00 PDT — Sun 06:00 PDT): P1 = 30m, P2 = 120m. After the window returns to your default SLOs.
2) On-call augmentation: we’ll put two dedicated responders in the APAC-evening/US-night overlap to reduce handoff risk; roster attached (temp_oncall_roster.xlsx).
3) Escalation path: first-line Redwood on-call -> Karthik Iyer (Operations lead) -> Laura Bennett (Head of Customer Success) -> Ben Carter (sales/exec escalation). PDF with contacts attached (escalation_contacts.pdf).
4) Billing: short-term uplift 25% on token/embedding usage for the 48-hour period, invoiced against DEAL-4821.
5) Paperwork: we’ll produce a one-page SLA addendum (DocuSign) — I’ll share the link once legal approves.

Next steps I need from you by Thursday EOD to lock this:
- Confirm the exact launch start/end in PDT (you listed 06:00 — please confirm).
- Confirm acceptance of the 25% uplift and the addendum.

If that sounds good we’ll route for internal approvals now — Karthik, can you confirm we have the capacity to staff the two-night responders and that SRE will accept the temporary augmentation? Laura, I’ll need one of your CSMs on standby during the window for customer liaison.

Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

---
attachments: temp_oncall_roster.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), escalation_contacts.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 02:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SLA coverage for launch weekend

Ben / Laura —

We can staff two dedicated responders for the Friday-Sunday window. I recommend the following operational controls to reduce blast radius:
- Continuous prefix caching enabled for AtlasPay model routes during the window.
- Autoscaling burst threshold increased by +20% for the 48-hour period (pre-warmed instances in SFO region).
- Midnight-to-06:00 PDT we’ll have primary responder + shadow responder (handoff every 4 hours).

I’ve signed off on the staffing; ops will need the final DocuSign addendum by EOD Friday to authorize the billing uplift.

Karthik
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference

Ben, Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. AtlasPay accepts the proposed temporary SLA amendment and the 25% uplift for the 48-hour window starting Friday 06:00 PDT. Confirming: Friday 2026-08-21 06:00 PDT — Sunday 2026-08-23 06:00 PDT.

Please send the one-page addendum (DocuSign) and final on-call roster to procurement; I’ll flag legal to expedite. Our engineering lead (cc’d) will be online during the window and available to collaborate on any live mitigations.

Appreciate the partnership — Samir
Samir Rao
Head of Platform, AtlasPay
